answer.says: Ramesh, this kadhi is quite good. The aloo gobhi is also well made. I shall take my time; there is no rush.
answer.thought: The body demands its due, and the spirit must consent to it. I sit down to the kadhi and rice; the heat has made me thirsty, and the food is a necessary pause before the heat of the afternoon. The file is in the hands of the state, and the state moves with a slowness that mirrors the pace of digestion.
